analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced host macro validation HR@10 from the supplied 0.5800 reference to 0.5363, a decline of 0.0437. Category HR@10 was 0.570 Movies_and_TV, 0.600 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.430 Electronics, and 0.545 CDs_and_Vinyl; all were below their supplied reference values. The result does not support untying the scoring embeddings under this training configuration. Reduced parameter sharing is a plausible explanation, but the reported metrics do not establish the cause. Allocated GPU time was 218.67 seconds.
code_summary: One independently trained masked bidirectional transformer per category: 96 hidden units, two transformer blocks, two heads, length 64, dropout 0.2. Input item embeddings and output scoring embeddings are separate parameters; the output table starts as an exact clone without consuming additional RNG. Positive, negative, and inference scores use the output table plus a jointly trained item bias. Training retains single-pass masked sampled softmax with 256 shared negatives and half the loss weight on the final query mask, using AdamW and seed 42. Each category exports exactly one validation-selected checkpoint, loaded strictly with architecture metadata and checked for predictor score parity. No ensemble, relative attention bias, or R-Drop is used.
